paragraphs.en: Make a stronger five-dice hand than your opponents and win the chips in the pot. Only you hear your rolls. Everyone takes a turn rolling and keeping a hand, then betting begins. The player with the most chips after the agreed number of rounds wins.

Press Enter for the first throw. Space reads the dice. To roll only some of them again, press 1–6 for the faces you want to reroll. Pressing 5 twice selects two fives if you have them. Shift with the same digit removes one die of that value from the selection.

Enter rerolls the selected dice and keeps the rest. If you are happy with the hand, press K to keep it, or choose the hand from the list after your final throw. You normally get up to three throws. With the opener limit, nobody in the round can use more throws than the first player. A different player opens the next round.

From strongest to weakest: five of a kind, four of a kind, full house, straight, three of a kind, two pair, one pair, and high die. A straight is 1–5 or 2–6, with 2–6 higher. Within a category, compare the dice that form the combination first, then the rest.
You can play without straights, or without straights and with ones ranked highest. Otherwise six is the highest face.
Everyone pays the opening stake, then takes their dice turn. Only you hear your dice and combination; the others hear that you roll. H recalls your hand, including while you wait or bet.

Betting starts after everyone keeps a hand. C checks or calls, R or B raises, F folds, and A goes all-in. Folding gives up your claim to the pot. When betting ends, the players still competing reveal their hands; folded hands stay hidden. If everyone but one player folds, that player wins without showing their dice.

The strongest hand wins the pot and ties split it. Odd chips are handed out in round order. You cannot win more from another player than you put in yourself. Any part of a bet nobody matched is returned. Highest balance wins at the round limit or when only one player still has chips. If nobody is eligible for a pot, the bets in it are returned. Equal highest balances draw.
Enter: roll or confirm
1–6: select a die of that value to reroll
Shift+1–6: unselect a die of that value
Space: read dice and selection
K: keep the current hand
H: read your hand
S: read chip balances
C: check or call
F: fold in betting
A: go all-in
R: raise
B: raise
